headline: As of 2026-10-22: 20,478,738 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 45 of 50 states, D+13.2 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 20,478,738 early/mail ballots cast so far across 45 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+13.2 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (2,472,643), California (2,350,922), Florida (1,912,570).
